## 主要发现 | Major findings

**中文。** 研究重新释读Xultun 10K-2建筑东墙的一段微型文字（Text 19），识别出一组协调历法与金星、火星等天体周期的数学—天文公式。公式结尾写有“so says Sak Tahn Waax”，把这项知识工作直接归于一位有名可考的历史人物。

**English.** Reanalysis of Text 19 on the east wall of Structure 10K-2 identified a mathematical-astronomical formula coordinating calendrical intervals with cycles including Venus and Mars. The text closes with the attribution “so says Sak Tahn Waax,” directly associating the calculation with a named historical individual.

## 学术重要性 | Intellectual significance

**中文。** 这是目前唯一已知由古典期玛雅数学家—天文学家直接署名或被明确归名的知识成果。它把玛雅科学从匿名的“文明成就”还原为具体学者、知识劳动和宫廷知识生产，同时显示复杂计算可能发生在接近手抄本工作坊的日常空间，而不只是纪念碑和王权仪式中。

**English.** This is the only known Classic Maya case in which mathematical-astronomical work is directly attributed to a named individual. It reframes Maya science as the work of identifiable scholars operating within social and courtly institutions, rather than as an anonymous civilizational achievement.
